"content": "Usage: mcpjam cloud eval run [options]\n\nStart an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a versioned suite file and
run\nit. The upload-and-launch has a 120s deadline overall, not per request (raise it\nwith the global --timeout <ms>); --wait-ti

meout bounds the RUN instead.

Options:
 --suite <id-or-name> Eval suite name or ID
 --file <path>
Versioned suite file to upload and run (.yaml or .json, or - for stdin)\n --project <id-or-name>
Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project)\n --server <id-or-name...> Overrid
e the suite's saved server selection (HTTP servers only)\n --environment <id-or-name...> Attached project environment
(s) to run. Several values start one PAID RUN each.\n --client <id-or-name...> Attached client(s) to run, so the
run is stamped with that client's config. Several values start one PAID RUN each.\n --host <id-or-name...> De
precated alias for --client. NOT the host-compat catalog id `mcpjam tools --host` takes.\n --all-targets
Run EVERY attached environment (or, if none, every attached host) — one PAID RUN per target\n --iterations <n>
Run each case this many times under verdict policy 2 (1-10)\n --repetitions <n> Legacy spellin
g of --iterations\n --case <id-or-title...> Run only these cases instead of the whole suite\n --exclude-skills
Run the 'without skills' arm: no skills are pinned, and the run is labelled as excluded\n --refresh-sna
pshot PERSISTS a new host-config snapshot on the suite, changing every future run of it. Single-target runs
only.\n --notes <text> Free-text note stored on the run\n --min-pass-rate <n>
Pass threshold for this run (0-100)\n --match-options <json> Tool-call match options for this run, e.g. '{\"to
olCallOrder\":\"exact\"}'\n --idempotency-key <key> Retry key for a lost launch response; for --file, one is mi
nted and printed when omitted\n --wait Wait for every started run to reach a terminal status\n
--wait-timeout <ms> Maximum time to wait for completion (default 600000; a run held for its judge gets up
to 31 more minutes unless this flag is set)\n --reporter <json-summary|junit-xml|html> Render the completed run report to stdout
\n --out <path> Atomically write the completed report selected by --reporter (default: json-summary)
\n --compose-client <id-or-name> Compose a stack to run instead of naming a saved environment: the client it runs as.
Default is EPHEMERAL (does not attach to the suite).\n --compose-host <id-or-name> Deprecated alias for --compose-
client\n --compose-computer <id-or-name> Sandbox image to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-model <id...>
Model(s) to run on the composed stack. Replaces the client default unless --with-client-default is set.\n --compose-mod
el-selection <json...> A whole saved model selection (source, connection, settings.reasoningEffort) as JSON (or @file, or -)
: one cell for its model, at its effort. Alongside --compose-model. Repeat it to add several selections for one model (e.g. at low
and at high) — each distinct selection is its own cell.\n --with-client-default Also launch an inherit cell
that uses each client's pinned model, alongside --compose-model\n --save-targets Attach the composed e
nvironments to the suite (append, capped at 10). Default is ephemeral.\n --compose-server <id-or-name...> Server(s) to p
in on the composed stack. Snapshots them into a server group, so the run keeps testing these servers even if the host's own server
list changes later. Mutually exclusive with --compose-server-group.\n --compose-server-group <id> Standalone serve
r group to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-host-servers No longer supported: eval runs take their server
s from a server group. Use --compose-server or --compose-server-group.\n --compose-skill <id...> Project-shared
skill IDs to pin on the composed stack\n --compose-secret <id...> Project SECRET IDs the composed stack grants
to its runs. Without one a composed stack carries no credential — list them with `mcpjam secrets list`.\nUsing MCPJam Cloud as sk_
